m: मैधातिथ mf(ई)n. relating to Medhātithi, ŚāṅkhŚr.
मैधातिथ n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr. (also मैध्यातिथ).
मैधाव m. (fr. मेधा-विन्) the son of a wise man, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 164, Sch.
मैधा˚वक n. intelligence, wisdom g. मनोज्ञादि.
a: मैधावकं — Wisdom, intelligence.

m: मैघ mf(ई)n. descended from clouds, VS.
belonging to clouds, cloudy, MW.
मैघ See p. 832, col. 2.

a: मैंदः — N. of a demon killed by Kṛṣṇa. --Comp. --हन् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

m: मैण्मिण्य n. = मिण्मिण-त्व, Car.
मैश्रधान्य n. (fr. मिश्र-धान्य) a dish prepared by mixing various grains, Kauś.

मैथिली—नाटक n. N. of wk.
मैथिली—परिणय m. N. of wk.
मैथिल mf(ई)n. relating or belonging to Mithilā, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

a: मैथिलः — [मिथिलायां भवः अण्] A king of Mithilā; R. 11. 32, 48. --लाः (pl.) The people of Mithilā q. v. --ली N. of Sītā; R. 12. 29.

m: मैथिल—कायस्थ m. N. of a poet, Cat.
मैथिल—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
मैथिल—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
मैथिल—वाचस्पति and मैथिल—श्री-दत्त, m. N. of two men, Cat.
मैथिलेय m. metron. fr. मैथिली, Ragh.
मैथिलिक m. pl. the inhabitants of Mithilā, MW.
मैथुनाभाषण n. a conversation in which allusions are made to sexual int˚, Mahāvy.
मैथुनाभिघात m. prohibition of sex˚ int˚, Suśr.
मैथुनी-भाव m. copulation, sexual union, R.

s: klI, (miTune samBavatIti । miTuna + “saMBUte .” 4 । 3 । 41 । iti aR । miTunasyedamityaR vA .) agnyADAnam । yaTA, manuSAtAtapO । “asapiRqA ca yA mAturasagotrA ca yA pituH । sA praSastA dbijAtInAM dArakarmmaRi mETune ॥ mETune miTunaSabdavAcye strIpuMsasADye agnyADAnaputtrotpattyAdO .” ityadvAhatattvam ॥ * ॥ saNgatam । ratam । ityamaraH । 3 । 3 । 121 ॥ “saNgatiH saNgamo dArasaMyogaH vivAha iti kaliNgaH ॥ rataM suratam । anayormETunam । miTunAt saNgame idamarTe svArTe ratO nizpAdyArTe vA zRaH । sambanDe surate yumme rASO miTunamizyate । iti vyAqiH .” iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ * ॥ Sezasya paryyAyaH । suratam 2 aBimAnitam 3 Darzitam 4 saMprayogaH 5 anAratam 6 abrahmacaryyakam 7 upasfzwam 8 triBadram 9 krIqAratnam 10 mahAsuKam 11 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ vyavAyaH 12 grAmyaDarmmaH 13 ratam 14 niDuvanam 15 । ityamaraH । 2 । 7 । 57 ॥ asya guRAH । DAtukzayakAritvam । ratisantAnadAtftvaYca । atiSayamETunasya SvAsakAsajvarakAritvam । amETunasya pramehameda granTirogAgnimAndyakAritvam । strIsaMsargarahitasya AyurajarASarIrabalavarRasTiropacitamAMsAni Bavanti । pUjyasTAnASucisTAnasekasTAnalokasamIpaprAtaHkAlasanDyAkAlaparvvakAlezu tasya tyAjyatvam । etatkarmmaRi rajasvalAkAmA malinA banDyA varRajyezWA vayojyezWA vyADiyuktANgahInAsatI veSyA yonidozayuktA sagotrA gurupatnI BikzukI kapawavrataDAriRI vfdDA ca tyAjyA ॥ rajasvalAgamane dfzwyAyustejaHkzayo'DarmmaSca Bavati । kapawavratayuktAgurupatnI sagotrAvfdDAgamane evaM parvvakAle sanDyAkAle ca strImETune pApamAyuHkzayaSca Bavati । vayorUpaguRopetAM kulaSIlasamanvitAm । aDikAmAM hfzwAmalaNkftAM vAjIkaraRapIqitAYca pramadAM hfzwo'DikAmaSca puruzaH seveta । SukravardDakadravyaM saSarkaraM SItalajalaM vA pItvA kAmabARacaYcalAM surUpAmanindyAM hfzwAM pramadAmAdyaprahare hfzwaH kAmuko gatvA tadanu suKaM svapet । asakfdgamane tu naro DAtuvEzamyameti । ratAnte snAnaM saSarkarakzIrapAnaM nidrA gOqikarasaBojanaYca hitam । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ * ॥ (“tatra praTame divase ftumatyAM mETunagamanamanAyuzyaM puMsAM Bavati । yaSca tatrADIyate garBaH sa prasavamAno vimucyate । dvitIye'pyevaM sUtikAgfhe vA । tftIye'pyevamasampUrRANgo'lpAyurvA Bavati । na ca pravarttamAne rakte bIjaM pravizwaM guRakaraM Bavati yaTA nadyAM pratisrotaH plAvidravyaM prakziptaM pratinivarttate nordDvaM gacCati tadbadeva drazwavyam । tasmA nniyamavatIM trirAtraM pariharet । ataHparaM mAsAdupeyAt .” “ftusnAtA tu yA nArI svapne mETunamAvahet । ArttavaM vAyurAdAya kukzO garBaM karoti hi ॥ mAsi mAsi vivardDeta garBiRyA garBalakzaRam । kalalaM jAyate tasyA varjjitaM pEtfkErguREH ॥” iti suSrute SArIrasTAne dvitIye'DyAye ॥) vratadivase azwANgamETunasya tyAjyatvaM yaTA, -- “smaraRaM kIrttanaM keliH prekzaRaM guhyaBAzaRam । saNkalpo'DyavasAyaSca kriyAnizpattireva ca । mETunaM viviDaM tyAjyaM vrate krIqAvivfdDaye ॥” iti brahmavEvartte gaRapatiKaRqe 4 aDyAyaH ॥ asya viDinizeDO yaTA, -- “ftAyupagamaH SastaH svapatnyAmavanopate ! । punnAmarkze SuBe kAle jyezWayugmAsu rAtrizu ॥ nAsnAtAM tu striyaM gacCennAturAM na rajasvalAm । nAnizwAM na prakupitAM nApraSastAM na gurvviRIm ॥ nAdakziRAM nAnyakAmAM nAkAmAM nAnyayozitam । kzutkzAmAmatiBuktAM vA svayaM vEBirguREryutaH ॥ snAtaH sragganDaDfk prIto nADmAtaH kzuDito'pi vA । sakAmaH sAnurAgaSca vyavAyaM puruyo vrajet ॥ caturdaSyazwamI cEva amAvAsyATa pUrRimA । parvvARyetAni rAjendra ! ravisaMkrAntireva ca ॥ tElastrImAMsasaMBogI parvvasvetezu vE pumAn । viRmUtraBojanaM nAma prayAti narakaM mftaH ॥ aSezaparvvasvetezu tasmAt saMyamiBirbbuDEH । BAvyaM sacCAstradevejyADyAnajapyaparErnarEH ॥ nAnyayonAvayonO vA nopaBuktOzaDastaTA । devadbijagurURAYca vyavAyI nASrayI Bavet ॥ cEtyacatvaratIrTezu nEva gozWe catuzpaTe । nEva SmaSAnopavane salilezu mahIpate ! ॥ proktaparvvasvaSezezu nEva BUpAla ! sanDyayoH । gacCedvyavAyaM matimAnna mUtroccArapIqitaH ॥ parvvasvaBigamo'Danyo divA pApaprado nfpa ! । Buvi rogAvaho nFRAmapraSasto jalASaye ॥ paradArAnna gacCeta manasApi kadAcana । kimu vAcAsTibanDo'pi nAsti tezu vyavAyinAm ॥ mfto narakamaByeti hIyate'trApi cAyuzaH । paradAragatiH puMsAmuBayatrApi BItidA ॥ iti matvA svadArezu ftumatsu buDo vrajet । yaToktadozahInezu sakAmezvanftAvapi ॥” iti vizRupurARe । 3 । 11 । 111-124 ॥ * ॥ parastryAdigamane daRqo yaTA, -- “brAhmaRaH kzattriyo vESyaH kzattraviwSUdrayozitaH । vrajandApyo BavedrAjYA daRqa uttamasAhasam ॥ vESyAgame ca viprasya kzattriyasyAntyajAgame । maDyamaM praTamaM vESyo daRqyaH SUdrAgamAdBavet ॥ SUdraH savarRAgamane SataM daRqyo mahIBujA । vESyaSca dbiguRaM rAjan ! kzattriyastriguRaM taTA ॥ brAhmaRaSca BaveddaRqyastaTA rAjaMScaturguRam । aguptAsu BaveddaRqaH svaguptAsvaDiko Bavet ॥ mAtA mAtfzvasA SvaSrUrmAtulAnI pitfzvasA । pitfvyasaKiSizyastrI BaginI tatsaKI taTA ॥ BAgineyI taTA cEva rAjapatnI taTEva ca । taTA pravrajitA nArI varRotkfzwA taTEva ca ॥ ityagamyAstu nirddizwAstAsAntu gamane naraH । SiSnasyotkarttanaM kftvA tatastu vaDamarhati ॥ BrAtfBAryyAgame pUrvvAddaRqastu dbiguRo Bavet । cARqAlIYca SvapAkIM vA gacCan vaDamavApnuyAt । tiryyagyonO ca govarjyaM mETunaM yo'Bisevate । sa paRaM prAptuyAddaRqaM tasyASca yavasodakam ॥ suvarRaYca BaveddaRqyo gAM vrajan manujottama ! । vESyAgAmI dbijo daRqyo vESyaSulkasamaM paRam ॥ gfhItvA vetanaM veSyA loBAdanyatra gacCati । vetanaM dbiguRaM dadyAddaRqaYca dviguRantaTA ॥ anyamuddiSya yo dadyAt nayedanyasya kAraRAt । tasya daRqaM BavedrAjan ! suvarRasya ca mAzakam ॥ nItvA BogAnna yo dadyAddApyo dviguRavetanam । rAjYaSca dbiguRaM daRqantaTA Darmmo na hIyate ॥ bahUnAM vrajatAmekAM sarvve te dviguRaM damam । dadyuH pfTak pfTak sarvve daRqaYca dbiguRaM param ॥” iti mAtsye 201 aDyAyaH ॥

m: मैथुन mf(ई)n. (fr. मिथुन) paired, coupled, forming a pair or one of each sex, BhP.
connected by marriage, PārGṛ.
relating or belonging to copulation, KaṭhUp.; Mn.; MBh. (with भोग m. carnal enjoyment; with धर्म m. ‘sexual law’, copulation; with वासस् n. a garment worn during cop˚)
मैथुन n. (ifc. f(आ). ) copulation, sexual intercourse or union, marriage, ŚBr. &c. &c. (acc. with √ आस्, इ, गम्, चर्; dat. with उप-√ गम्, or उप√ क्रम्, to have sexual intercourse)
मैथुन n. union, connection, L.
a: मैथुन — a. (नी f.) [मिथुपेन निर्वृत्तं अण्] 1 Paired, coupled. --2 United by marriage. --3 Relating to copula tion. --नं 1 Copulation, sexual union; मृतं मैथुनमप्रजं Pt. 2. 94. --2 Marriage. --3 Union, connection. --4 Consecrating the fire (अग्न्याधान). --Comp. --ज्वरः the excitement of sexual passion. --धर्मिन् a. copulating. --वैराग्यं abstinence from sexual intercourse.

k.v: व्यवायो ग्राम्यधर्मो मैथुनं निधुवनं रतम्. त्रिवर्गो धर्मकामार्थैश्चतुर्वर्गः समोक्षकैः॥
अकार्यगुह्ये कौपीनं मैथुनं सङ्गतौ रते। प्रधानं परमात्मा धीः प्रज्ञानं बुद्धिचिह्नयोः॥
अकार्यगुह्ये कौपीनं मैथुनं सङ्गतौ रते। प्रधानं परमात्मा धीः प्रज्ञानं बुद्धिचिह्नयोः॥

m: मैथुन—धर्मिन् mfn. cohabiting, copulating, BhP.
मैथुन—गमन n. sexual intercourse, Suśr.
मैथुन—गत mfn. engaged in copulation, MBh.
मैथुन—ज्वर m. sexual passion, MBh.
मैथुन—वैराग्य n. abstinence from sexual intercourse, MW.
मैथुनिका f. (इका) union by marriage, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 125.
a: मैथुनिका — Union by marriage, matrimonial {{allianee->alliance||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}}.

m: मैथुनिक mfn. (ifc.) having sexual intercourse, MBh.
मैथुनिन् mfn. = prec. mfn., Mn.; MārkP.
मैथुनिन् m. Ardea Sibirica, L.
a: मैथुनिन् — a. Copulating, sexually united. --m. One who has had sexual union with a woman.

m: मैथुनोपगमन n. = ˚न-गमन, ib.
मैथुन्य mfn. proceeding from or caused by or relating to copulation, Mn.; BhP.
a: मैथुन्य — a. Relating to copulation.

m: मैहिक mf(ई)n. (fr. मेह) relating to urinary disease, Suśr.

a: मैलिंदः — A bee.

m: मैनाक m. (fr. मेना) N. of a mountain (son of Hima-vat by Menā or Menakā, and said to have alone retained his wings when Indra clipped those of the other mountains; accord. to some this mountain was situated between the southern point of the Indian peninsula and Laṅkā), TĀr. (v.l. मैनाग), AV.Pariś.; MBh. &c.
N. of a Daitya, Hariv.
a: मैनाकः — [मेनकायां भवः अण्] N. of a mountain, son of Himālaya and Menā, who alone retained his wings (when Indra clipped those of other mountains) on account of his friendship with the ocean; cf. Ku. 1. 20. --Comp. --स्वसृ f. an epithet of Pārvatī.

m: मैनाक—भगिनी and मैनाक—स्वसृ, f. ‘sister of Maināka’, N. of Pārvatī, L.
मैनाक—प्रभव m. N. of the river Śoṇa, VP.
मैनाल m. (fr. मीन) a fisherman, VS. (Sch.)
a: मैनालः — A fisherman.

m: मैनवी f. (prob. fr. मीन) a kind of gait or movement, Saṃgīt.

m: मैन्द m. N. of a monkey-demon killed by Kṛṣṇa, MBh.; R.

मैरावण—चरित्र n. N. of wk.
मैरव mf(ई)n. (fr. मेरु) relating to mount Meru, Prab.

v: na॰ mittrasya BAvaH aR vA zyaY pakze NIp yalopaH । sOhArde mEttryamapyatra na॰ ।

na॰ mitro devatAsya aR mEtraM pAyustasyedaM punaraR । 1 vizWotsarge “mEtraM karma samAcaret” iti smftiH । mitro devatA'sya, mittrata AgataM tasyedaM vA aR । 2 anurADAnakzatre na॰ । tasya hi mitro devatA । 3 mittrataH prApte “mEttramOdvAhikaYcEva” smftiH । 3 suhftsambanDini ca tri॰ । mittrameva svArTe prajYAdyaR । 5 mittre 6 brAhmaRe ca pu॰ trikA॰ ।
